podcast.title: Early Cover Band
podcast.body: The Slinks were one of Gord Downie's early musical groups during his high school years, performing cover songs. "His early groups included a cover band called The Slinks."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: High School Band
podcast.body: Gord Downie fronted this high school band when he was in grade 11 at Kingston Collegiate Vocational High. "In grade 11, Gord fronted a high school band called The Slinks."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Early Connection to The Slinks and Gord Downie
xref.body: Served as Gord Downie's "light guy" for his first high school band, The Slinks. Dillon later briefly joined The Slinks as a singer after Downie moved on. "I was Gordowney's light guy at the first high school dance where his band called the slinks performed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Headstones: In Their Own Words Part 1

xref.title: Early Encounters with Hugh Dillon
xref.body: Dillon served as Downie's "light guy" for The Slinks' inaugural high school dance performance. Downie also purchased LSD from Dillon during their high school years. "I was Gordowney's light guy at the first high school dance where his band called the slinks performed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Headstones: In Their Own Words Part 1

xref.title: Gord Downie's First Band
xref.body: Was a member of The Slinks, Gord Downie's first band, where Hugh Dillon once served as the "light guy." "In frontini who was in Gord's first band, the slanks, who I had done, uh, lights for."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Headstones: In Their Own Words Part 1

xref.title: Kingston Upbringing and Early Connections
xref.body: Grew up in Kingston, attending high school with Hugh Dillon. He was the frontman for his first band, The Slinks, and later became the iconic singer of The Tragically Hip. "I grew up in Kingston with David Usher and the guys in the hip. We all went to the same high school."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Headstones: In Their Own Words Part 1

xref.title: Kingston to Toronto Music Scene
xref.body: Mentioned as one of the musicians from Kingston who moved to Toronto, highlighting his connections to Gord Downie's first band, The Slinks, and his involvement in 13 Engines. "Grant Echie, who was in 13 engines. He was in Gord Downey's first band, the slanks."
